data: Eliminate the egg with a key to unlock the egg locked by a chain.
Click on the adjacent bird three times to defrost the ice block
When the egg fall to the bottom, you can see clearly the bird inside.
Match other birds to break the ice.
Match the target bird to open the egg.
Help all the birds return to their nests to win
